metadata.name: onevault
metadata.description: 1Vault - Non-custodial strategy vault protocol on Solana

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: Remaining vault capital is unwrapped to native SOL for each share holder
via remaining_accounts triples: share ATA, unwrap PDA, destination wallet.

accounts.name: strategist_share_account
docs: Strategist must hold vault shares (same pool as retail).

errors.name: InsufficientLicenseBalance
errors.msg: Insufficient platform token balance for license

errors.name: VaultNotClosing
errors.msg: Vault is not in closing state

errors.name: VaultHasShares
errors.msg: Close vault must include every remaining share holder

errors.name: ZeroDeposit
errors.msg: Deposit amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ZeroWithdraw
errors.msg: Withdraw amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: AssetNotAccepted
errors.msg: Asset mint not accepted by vault

errors.name: StandardRouteRequired
errors.msg: Standard route required for this vault MEV mode

errors.name: TpSlNotTriggered
errors.msg: Take profit or stop loss not triggered

errors.name: StrategistMustPark
errors.msg: Strategist must park SOL in the vault before trading

fields.name: take_profit_bps
docs: Retail mandate: take-profit in bps of entry. Degen still executes the close.

fields.name: stop_loss_bps
docs: Retail mandate: stop-loss in bps of entry.

types.name: TradeVenue
docs: Where the swap executes — DEX aggregator/AMM vs launchpad bonding curve.

fields.name: squads_multisig
docs: Squads / external multisig that holds Solana program upgrade authority (optional).

fields.name: program_buffer
docs: Program buffer account that will receive the new .so bytecode.
